newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: STORK TO SHED MODULAR PUMPS BUSINESS.
newsitem.headline: STORK TO SHED MODULAR PUMPS BUSINESS.

text.p: Industrial systems and services group Stork NV said on Tuesday it expected Sweden's Johnson Pump International AB to acquire Stork's modular pumps business.

Stork said its modular pumps business and Johnson Pump had complementary geographical markets and product ranges, adding that the planned deal would create a pumps company with annual sales of some 200 million guilders.
Stork's modular pumps business has annual sales of just over 100 million guilders and has units in the Netherlands, Belgium, France, Germany, Britain and Spain. It employs 400 people.
A Stork manager declined to comment on the purchase price to be paid by Johnson Pump, whose shares are listed on the Gothenburg stock exchange in Sweden.
He added that the deal would not affect Stork's projected earnings for 1996.
